routing_rule: task relevance first (pick the route by intent), then quality (pool is quality-ranked; first entry is the default)

general-chat.match: general chat, Q&A, summarization, writing, planning
general-chat.tier_hint: first = highest measured quality; use cost/latency in models[] to trade down

coding.match: code generation, debugging, code review, code explanation
coding.order_note: re-sort by codeScore from benchmark: qwen2.5-coder-32b (code specialist, q=55 overall) leads on code despite overall rank

reasoning-math.match: math, multi-step reasoning, logic puzzles, constraint solving

structured-output.match: JSON, SQL, regex, strict schema output

tool-calling.match: function/tool calling, agent tool use, typed calls
tool-calling.order_note: quality-ranked among models that passed the tool-calling probe

decision-scoring.match: yes/no gates, N-option picks, probability scores, triage/classify
decision-scoring.order_note: nativeScore from 2026-10-30 (clef-omni 80, clef 79, clef-flash 74, clairic 68); clairic-flash placed after clef-flash on bench-lite 2026-11-23 (4/4), flash latency

safety-moderation.order_note: its low generic qualityScore is a harness artifact (guard-only model, correct-by-design for this task)

cheap-high-throughput.match: bulk jobs where cost dominates quality

embeddings.match: text embeddings, semantic search, RAG vectors
embeddings.order_note: quality from retrieval probes (qwen3-0.6b tops the probe); workspace default stays bge-m3 (1024-D, matches existing Vectorize indexes)

multimodal-embeddings.order_note: bench-lite 2026-11-23: 768-dim, retrieval 3/3. NOT index-compatible with bge-m3 (1024-D): never mix in one Vectorize index

image-to-text.order_note: no quality probes; llama-vision = instruct vision (Q&A about images), moondream = caption/description specialist

image-classification.match: label an image against fixed classes

text-to-image.match: generate an image from a prompt
text-to-image.order_note: no quality probes; flux-2-dev is the quality default, flux-1-schnell the fast one, klein-* the light ones; leonardo models last (unproven)

speech-to-text.order_note: no quality probes; whisper-large-v3-turbo = accuracy default, nova-3 = deepgram high-accuracy, flux = streaming-native, whisper = fallback

text-to-speech.order_note: no quality probes; aura-2-en for English, aura-2-es for Spanish, aura-1 fallback

sentiment.order_note: low generic score is a harness artifact; task-correct model
